meta.name: pipeline-rnaseq
meta.description: Execute ENCODE RNA-seq pipeline from FASTQ to gene quantification and signal tracks. Child of pipeline-guide. Provides Nextflow execution with Docker and cloud deployment. Use when processing RNA-seq data with STAR alignment, RSEM/Kallisto quantification, or generating expression matrices. Trigger on: RNA-seq pipeline, gene expression, STAR alignment, RSEM quantification, transcript quantification, TPM, FPKM, RNA processing, run RNA-seq.

copy.tagline: 从FASTQ文件自动运行RNA-seq分析流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在RNA-seq数据上执行标准化的基因定量和信号追踪流程。
